name: run-flow-invalid-file-exception
description: runFlow's target file exists but fails to parse, reporting the parse failure as an "Exception: " detail rather than "Sub-flow file not found", since only the file read is caught on both sides
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: runFlow invalid file
---
- launchApp
- runFlow:
    file: "{{DIR}}/invalid-sub-flow.yml"
